text: {"findings":[{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Repeats EXP-035 without referencing it","detail":"EXP-035 already tested live-tracking push notifications to reduce where-is-my-order contacts. It shipped, and it found fatigue and opt-outs after the third push, with a learning to cap pushes at two per order. The proposal does not cite it, and it does not include a push cap or any fatigue or opt-out handling.","evidence_quote":"Send live tracking push notifications when the driver is five minutes away.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-035-live-tracking-nudges"],"recommendation":"Reference EXP-035, state what is new versus that test, and apply the two-pushes-per-order cap. Add opt-out or fatigue monitoring to the design."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Unsourced 35% contact reduction claim","detail":"The 35% reduction is stated as fact with no source. It also conflicts with the proposal's own target of 8.4 to 7.0 per 100, which is about a 17% reduction, and with the -7% result from the earlier EXP-035 test.","evidence_quote":"This will cut where-is-my-order contacts by 35%.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-035-live-tracking-nudges"],"recommendation":"Remove the 35% claim or cite its source.
